standard_prerequisites: Universal purity of a flat module of finite presentation that is pure relative to the base, and the purity-on-top criterion relating purity to the associated points of the fibres
The criterion reducing representability to representability over schemes, and etale locality of closed immersions and of descent data for sheaves

The existence of a chart over an affine etale neighbourhood on which the pullback of the module is projective and whose image contains the fibre, the constructibility of the relative assassin, and the criterion that a map is injective exactly when its pullback along a universally separating morphism is
The affine case for a projective module over the coordinate ring of an affine base
core_obligations: Deduce universal purity from the assumptions, and reduce representability to the case of a scheme base by pulling the whole situation back along a morphism from a scheme

Use etale locality of closed immersions to pass to an affine neighbourhood of a point and to a chart on which the pullback of the module is projective and whose image contains the fibre over that point

Observe that the set of points of the base where the associated points of the fibres lie in the image of the chart is constructible, and that by purity along the fibre it contains the local ring at the given point, hence contains an open neighbourhood after shrinking

Conclude that the associated points of the module over the base lie in the image of the chart, and use the universally separating property of the chart to reduce injectivity of the given map to injectivity of its pullback, which holds after any base change

Finish the representability by the affine case for a projective module, and obtain finite presentation of the structure morphism from the finite type assumption together with the characterisation of local finite presentation
proof_roadmap: Reduce to a scheme base and to an affine etale neighbourhood with a projective chart
Use constructibility of the relative assassin and purity on top to shrink until the associated points lie in the chart
Reduce injectivity to the chart by the universally separating property
Conclude by the affine projective case and get finite presentation
difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is the representability of the zero locus of a map into a pure finite presentation module as a closed immersion at source lines 1706-1717, label lemma-F-zero-closed-pure, whose proof occupies source lines 1719-1787. The proof combines several independent moves: it upgrades purity to universal purity, reduces representability to scheme bases, and then, after passing to an affine etale neighbourhood, uses a chart on which the module becomes projective to turn the injectivity question into the affine projective case. The delicate step in the middle is a constructibility argument: the set of points of the base whose fibre associated points lie in the image of the chart is constructible and contains the local ring at the given point by purity along the fibre, so after shrinking the base the associated points lie in the chart, and the universally separating property of the chart then transfers injectivity. Finite presentation of the structure morphism is obtained separately from the finite type assumption. The counted statement records none of this.
